title: TempoBridge: Source-Conditioned Flow Matching with Optimal Transport Couplings for Single-Cell Population Transitions
abstract: arXiv:2610.04945v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Destructive single-cell measurements provide unpaired population snapshots rather than observations of the same cells across conditions. Local cell states and transition requests may also be insufficient to distinguish responses across source populations. We introduce TempoBridge, a common source-conditioned transport formulation for temporal, genetic, and chemical population transitions. Source cells initialize latent transport and provide a fixed empirical population summary. The velocity field receives this summary alongside the evolving cell state, flow time, and a structured transition descriptor. Minibatch optimal transport (OT) supplies couplings only for conditional flow-matching training paths; inference requires neither target expression nor OT computation. On held-out donors, TempoBridge achieves an Energy distance of 0.129 versus 0.144 for scGen. Genetic mean-expression $L_2$ error is 2.261 versus 3.156 for scGPT-sc

translated_title: TempoBridge：基于最优传输耦合的源条件流匹配用于单细胞群体转变
translated_abstract: 破坏性的单细胞测量提供的是非配对的群体快照，而非同一批细胞在不同条件下的观测。同时，局部细胞状态和转变请求也可能不足以区分不同来源群体的响应差异。我们提出了TempoBridge，一个适用于时间、基因和化学群体转变的统一源条件传输框架。源细胞用于初始化潜在传输，并提供一个固定的经验群体摘要。速度场接收该摘要以及不断演化的细胞状态、流时间和一个结构化的转变描述符。小批量最优传输（OT）仅为条件流匹配的训练路径提供耦合；推理阶段既不需要目标表达数据，也无需OT计算。在留出的供体数据上，TempoBridge实现了0.129的Energy距离，优于scGen的0.144。在基因扰动任务上，其平均表达的$L_2$误差为2.261，优于scGPT-sc的3.156。
tldr: TempoBridge提出了一个统一的源条件流匹配框架，利用小批量最优传输耦合进行训练且推理时无需最优传输计算，在时间、基因和化学扰动的单细胞群体转变预测上超越了scGen和scGPT等现有方法。
en_tdlr: TempoBridge introduces a unified source-conditioned flow matching framework with minibatch optimal transport couplings for training and OT-free inference, outperforming scGen and scGPT on predicting single-cell population transitions across temporal, genetic, and chemical perturbations.
